# Ben Tran — Regional Merchandiser

- **Relationship:** cross-org partner from **Merchandising**; sets planograms and controls the **regional
  fixture budget and allocation** across all stores in the region.
- **Cadence:** monthly merchandising call; ad-hoc during resets and remodels.
- **Owns:** planogram packages, seasonal reset timing, and — critically — **fixture allocation**. He is the
  approver who releases fixture funding to a store.
- **⚠️ Current blocker:** Ben is **holding the fixture package for the [Northgate Remodel](../projects/northgate-remodel.md)**
  because the region put fixture spend under a **freeze until Q4**. Nothing on the remodel can proceed past
  demo until Ben releases the fixtures — **he is the blocker, and the budget freeze is the reason.** Marc has
  a commitment to file a budget appeal through him and Renata.
- **How to work with him:** he responds to a clean business case — sqft, expected comp lift, and the cost of
  delay. Don't go around him to his boss; he controls the calendar and will remember it.
